title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
statement: Return the kth largest value by sort order, not the kth distinct value. Duplicates count each time they appear.
hints: Sorting and indexing from the end is O(n log n) and passes comfortably.
For O(n log k), keep a min-heap of size k: push everything, and drop the smallest whenever the heap grows past k. The root is then the answer.
For average O(n), quickselect partitions around a pivot and recurses into only one side.
complexity: O(n log n) sorting, O(n log k) with a heap
